working_geometry_plain: The working Phase 2 geometry is PEPS3D-anchored finite response-quotient carrier geometry. After X, active coordinate-pair deletion collapses each active-pair row from three support-mask classes to two. The next candidate only quotients those finite deleted-mask rows into collision classes and singleton residues; it does not claim topology, all-subset minimality, restoration, inverse, full coordinate coverage, or downstream geometry.

candidate_maps_considered.candidate_name: finite collision-residue quotient of active-pair deleted masks
candidate_maps_considered.finite_map: Z_active_pair_collision_residue_K : (X_loss_active_coordinate_pair_deletion_collapse_K, active_pair_deleted_masks, kappa:deleted_mask -> collision_class, complement:A2 -> A\pair) -> finite active-pair collision partition table + singleton residue table + complement-coordinate readout + F-boundary no-collision controls
why_admissible: It ratchets directly from X by adding an explicit finite equivalence relation kappa on each active-pair deleted-mask row: deleted masks are equivalent iff their V/E/F/C bit vectors match.
The operation is finite: three active-pair rows and three F-boundary rows inherited from X.
The output is finite: one collision partition per active-pair row, one singleton residue per active-pair row, a complement-coordinate readout, and no-collision F-boundary controls.
It remains PEPS3D-anchor explicit because every collision/residue class is a quotient of V/E/F/C anchored deleted masks.
It is not topology, all-subset minimality, restore/inverse, or downstream geometry; it is only a finite partition/readout over X rows.
candidate_maps_considered.geometry_it_would_earn_if_later_passed: A bounded finite collision-residue quotient on the Phase 2 pair-deletion carrier: each active coordinate-pair deletion has one size-2 collision class and one singleton residue, while each F-boundary pair has no collision.

candidate_maps_considered.candidate_name: finite class-pair row deletion coverage stability
candidate_maps_considered.why_deferred: Finite and carrier-local, but less direct after X than the collision partition already exposed by X active-pair deleted masks.

candidate_maps_considered.why_rejected: X tests active coordinate-pair deletions plus F-boundary controls only; it does not cover all subsets or prove minimality.
Collision partitions of finite bit masks do not admit topology, sheaf, homology, persistence, or gluing closure.
Deleted-mask collisions are many-to-one collapse rows and do not provide restoration or inverse evidence.
Hopf/Weyl, terrain, substages, flux, Xi/Phi0, Axis0, physics, IGT, and axes 7-12 remain blocked consumers.

selected_candidate_map.finite_map: Z_active_pair_collision_residue_K : (X_loss_active_coordinate_pair_deletion_collapse_K, active_pair_deleted_masks, kappa:deleted_mask -> collision_class, complement:A2 -> A\pair) -> finite active-pair collision partition table + singleton residue table + complement-coordinate readout + F-boundary no-collision controls

domain.kappa: finite equivalence relation on deleted support-mask rows: m ~ n iff m and n have identical V/E/F/C bit vectors
domain.complement: finite map from active coordinate pair to the omitted active coordinate in {V,E,C}
domain.legal_anchor_preserving_coordinate_names: coordinate names must remain PEPS3D V/E/F/C anchor categories; coordinate-category scrambles are controls only

selected_candidate_map.codomain_or_output: finite collision partition table, active-pair size-2 collision classes, singleton residue table, complement-coordinate readout, F-boundary no-collision table, and nonpromotion controls
selected_candidate_map.PEPS3D_carrier_anchor: Every collision/residue row is a quotient of inherited PEPS3D V/E/F/C deleted-mask rows from X.
selected_candidate_map.F01_witness: finite X row set, finite deleted-mask rows, finite equivalence relation kappa, finite collision/residue partitions, finite F-boundary controls, and finite output rows
selected_candidate_map.N01_order_witness: Inherited from the Phase 2 carrier chain through X; order-erased rows must remain non-claim-bearing and Z is not admitted as a new noncommuting operator.
selected_candidate_map.positive_case: active rows VE, VC, and EC each produce one size-2 collision class and one singleton residue; complement coordinates are C, E, and V respectively; F-boundary rows VF, EF, and CF produce three singleton classes and no active collision

positive: VE, VC, and EC active rows each have exactly one size-2 collision class
VE, VC, and EC active rows each have exactly one singleton residue
active-row complement coordinate readout is VE->C, VC->E, EC->V
VF, EF, and CF boundary rows have no size-2 collision class
negative: norm-only data cannot emit deleted-mask collision partitions
scalar-label data cannot bind collision classes to PEPS3D V/E/F/C masks
no-anchor collision counts cannot be claim-bearing evidence
fake-face-positive control must fail because F-boundary rows remain no-collision controls
boundary: F-boundary rows are no-collision controls, not active positives
Z does not test all coordinate subsets
Z does not prove restoration or inverse
bond and site values stay inherited from X; no convergence law is admitted
order_erased: order-erased source rows must stay non-claim-bearing
commuting-only evidence cannot admit the inherited carrier witness
downstream_leak: Phase 7/downstream receipts must not be dependencies
Hopf/Weyl, terrain, substages, flux, Xi/Phi0, Axis0, Holodeck/FEP, physics, IGT, and axes 7-12 remain blocked

failure_conditions: any active row lacks exactly one size-2 collision class
any active row lacks exactly one singleton residue
complement-coordinate readout differs from VE->C, VC->E, EC->V
any F-boundary row has a size-2 collision class
no explicit PEPS3D V/E/F/C anchors survive in the collision partition table
no-anchor, scalar-label, norm-only, fake-face, or order-erased controls reproduce claim-bearing collision rows
the map requires dense full-state closure or dense environment closure
